use_when: security or correctness needs independent evidence
repository dependency or API behavior may have changed
a bug needs upstream issue/documentation confirmation
source_priority: the target repository, tests, issues, pull requests, and CI runs
independent search providers (web search and Exa) for complementary coverage

expand_only_if: the first search results are insufficient
the task explicitly requires broad comparison across multiple available search sources

token_optimization: Prefer repository-local deterministic tests and static checks before any model/API call
Send only relevant file excerpts, diffs, errors, and test summaries; do not resend whole repositories or repeated context
Use one model/API call for routine work; use a second only for a meaningful independent review
Use concise structured outputs and bounded output tokens
Reuse stable prompt prefixes and cached results where supported and verified
Never call paid external AI APIs unless explicitly approved; do not infer free-tier availability without checking account terms
Measure tokens and cost only from actual API usage logs and official rates; otherwise report unavailable
Use deterministic local code for JSON, schema, arithmetic, and format validation; make zero external AI API calls when code can decide correctly
Prefer usage metadata returned by an existing API response; do not issue a separate token-count API request unless its result changes a decision
Reuse only verified cached results; do not assume caching is available or free, and never create paid caches without explicit approval
Pass only the relevant diff, changed files, and concise failure output instead of replaying full repository context
For research tasks, use complementary search sources only when they add distinct evidence; deduplicate results and stop once decision-critical facts are verified.

on_each_run: Read applicable policy and preserve the existing schedule
Use internet research when it materially improves correctness or freshness; search official docs/release notes and repository sources first
Reuse search results and avoid duplicate queries; default to at most two searches, use a third only when sources conflict or a decision-critical fact remains unresolved, and never exceed three.
Prefer free public sources and local tests; paid search/API/model calls require explicit approval
Minimize tokens by sending focused diffs and relevant excerpts, reusing stable prompts, and keeping outputs concise
Check enabled status and recent execution result when tools permit
Use one AI call for routine checks and a second only for material issues
Do not change, disable, delete, or reschedule existing automations without explicit approval
Report configured, attempted, and verified-success states separately

github_actions.note: Workflow validates repository policy/tests; it does not itself execute or control the scheduled automation.
